# Install everything with: pip install -r requirements.txt
#
# This file is curated by hand -- one line per genuinely direct dependency,
# with comments explaining why each is needed. For the exact, complete,
# currently-working set of versions (direct + transitive), see
# requirements-lock.txt (auto-generated, regenerate it after installing
# anything new with `powershell -File sync_requirements_lock.ps1`).
#
# --- Extra package indexes -------------------------------------------------
# torch: PyPI's default wheel pulls in CUDA libraries even on a CPU-only box
# (multi-GB of unnecessary bloat); the official CPU-only index avoids that.
# llama-cpp-python: needs a local C++ toolchain to build from source, which
# most Windows boxes don't have -- this index carries prebuilt CPU wheels.
# Both are listed as plain `--extra-index-url` (not `--index-url`), so pip
# still falls back to PyPI for every other package in this file.
--extra-index-url https://download.pytorch.org/whl/cpu
--extra-index-url https://abetlen.github.io/llama-cpp-python/whl/cpu
--prefer-binary
--only-binary=llama-cpp-python

# fury-sdk isn't published to PyPI; install from the sibling satellite repo.
# The base install needs only httpx/numpy/termcolor. [tts] additionally pulls
# in NeuTTS-nano's real deps (torch, llama-cpp-python, neucodec, onnxruntime,
# phonemizer) used by neu_tts.py for the actual neural voice -- without them,
# tts.py silently falls back to the robotic Pyttsx3/SAPI voice with no error,
# which is exactly the "rugged and metallic voice" regression this file
# previously shipped by omission. Also needs the espeak-ng system library
# (not pip-installable -- `winget install eSpeak-NG.eSpeak-NG` on Windows,
# `apt-get install espeak-ng` on Linux, `brew install espeak` on macOS).
-e ../../fury-main[tts]
torch>=2.10.0
llama-cpp-python>=0.3.0
neucodec>=0.0.5
phonemizer>=3.2.0
soundfile>=0.13.0

# Real semantic memory search (memory/graph.py's SentenceTransformerEmbedding)
# -- replaces the old hashed-bag-of-words placeholder, which could only ever
# match literal shared words, never actual meaning. all-MiniLM-L6-v2 (22M
# params) is small enough to run fast on CPU; torch is already required above.
sentence-transformers>=3.0.0

# Real cron-expression scheduling (cron_store.py's CronJob.cron_expression /
# is_due) -- replaces the old fixed-daily-hour/minute-only scheduler so jobs
# can run e.g. "every 15 minutes" or "9am weekdays", not just once a day.
croniter>=2.0.0

# Real MCP (Model Context Protocol) client (mcp_client.py) -- lets Nancy
# connect to actual third-party MCP servers (filesystem, git, search, etc.)
# and use their genuine tools through Claude's tool-use loop. Official SDK,
# real JSON-RPC framing/session lifecycle, not a hand-rolled approximation.
mcp>=1.0.0

# Real web-page fetching for Claude's tool-use loop (web_tool.py) -- parses
# real HTML into readable text (script/style/nav stripped), no paid
# browser-automation provider needed for a simple "read this page" tool.
beautifulsoup4>=4.12.0

# Real local computer-use: screenshot + mouse/keyboard control of this
# machine (computer_use_tool.py). Every action requires a live Telegram
# approval -- see that file's module docstring for why this is the one
# capability with no safe-by-default subset.
pyautogui>=0.9.54

faster-whisper>=0.9.0
pyttsx3>=2.90
python-socketio>=5.9.0
python-dotenv>=1.0.0
pydantic>=2.6.0
pydantic-settings>=2.6.0  # config/settings.py needs this separately-packaged split from pydantic v2 -- was missing entirely
numpy>=1.24.0
sounddevice>=0.4.6
fastapi>=0.104.0
# Pinned exact -- a loose >= range here sent pip's resolver into a
# multi-thousand-second backtracking loop trying every uvicorn release from
# 0.50.2 down to 0.39.0 one at a time hunting for a graph that satisfies
# everything; confirmed this is pre-existing (unrelated to anything added
# today) by reproducing it with the loose range restored. Pinned to the
# version already proven working (this exact codebase, running natively).
uvicorn==0.51.0
aiohttp>=3.9.0
# Imported directly (main_new.py's economic-calendar/webhook calls) -- was
# only ever present transitively (via anthropic/fury-sdk), which means a
# future version of either dropping it would silently break this file.
# Pinned exact for the same resolver-backtracking reason as uvicorn above.
httpx==0.28.1
psutil>=5.9.0
scipy>=1.11.0
scikit-learn>=1.3.0
nltk>=3.8.0

# Windows COM, for pythoncom (tts.py's Pyttsx3TTS -- SAPI5 is COM-based and
# needs CoInitialize() per thread). Only ever present transitively via
# pyttsx3's own Windows dependency; listed explicitly since tts.py imports it
# directly. No-op / not installable on non-Windows, hence the marker.
pywin32>=306; sys_platform == "win32"

# skill_loader.py parses SKILL.md YAML frontmatter directly -- only ever
# present transitively before (via faster-whisper's dependency chain).
pyyaml>=6.0

# PDF extraction for agent registry generation (Phase 1.9)
pypdf>=4.0.0
# pdfplumber>=0.11.0  # optional; uncomment if preferred

# Image handling for Telegram map snapshots (map_snapshot.py, imported
# unconditionally by telegram_bot.py) -- was missing from this file entirely.
Pillow>=10.0.0

# Claude backend — required for AnthropicLLM (llm.py); official SDK, not raw HTTP
anthropic>=0.40.0
# aiosqlite for persistent memory storage (see memory/manager.py)
aiosqlite>=0.20.0

# Optional LLM provider backends (install as needed)
# openai>=1.0.0
# google-generativeai>=0.3.0

# Clap detection (clap_detection.py, satellite repo ../../clap-detection-main).
# torch is already required above. torchaudio is imported directly
# (clap_detection.py's torchaudio.transforms) and was installed on this box
# but missing from this file entirely -- listed explicitly now.
torchaudio>=2.1.0
# torchvision (clap_detection.py's torchvision.transforms.Resize) is still
# genuinely not installed here -- until it and pretrained weights are in
# place, CLAP_MODEL_PATH won't resolve and the feature honestly reports
# unavailable rather than fabricating a result. Uncomment once both are set up.
# torchvision

# Outbound WebSocket client (providers/transcription/realtime_ws.py) --
# connects OUT to a realtime speech API's own WS endpoint. Distinct from
# FastAPI/uvicorn's inbound WebSocket support (already covered by uvicorn's
# own dependencies) -- this is for Nancy acting as a WS *client*.
websockets>=13.0

# Real cryptography for channels/reef.py's message encryption (Fernet).
cryptography>=42.0

# Real embedded vector-DB memory backend (memory/lancedb_store.py) -- optional
# alternative to MemoryGraph's brute-force cosine scan, enabled via
# MEMORY_BACKEND=lancedb. Pulls in pyarrow as a transitive dependency.
lancedb>=0.15

# Real local TLS-intercepting egress proxy (egress_proxy.py / coverage_proxy.py).
mitmproxy>=11.0

# Real Language Server Protocol client (lsp_client.py) -- [all] pulls in the
# actual diagnostics-producing plugins (pyflakes, pycodestyle, mccabe); the
# bare package alone only gets jedi-based completion/hover/definition with
# no diagnostics output at all (confirmed live this session -- publishDiagnostics
# came back empty until pyflakes/pycodestyle were installed).
python-lsp-server[all]>=1.14.0

# Real Word document text extraction (doc_extraction.py) -- pypdf (PDF) is
# already a dependency via other tooling; python-docx is the .docx equivalent.
python-docx>=1.2.0

# Real LAN service discovery (mdns_discovery.py).
zeroconf>=0.140.0

# Real Docker-backed multi-tenant sandboxes (fleet/*.py) -- requires Docker
# Desktop (or another Docker Engine) actually running on this machine.
docker>=7.0.0

# Real browser automation (browser_tool.py) -- navigate/click/fill/screenshot
# actual rendered pages with real JS execution, headless (no display needed,
# unlike app_launcher.py's GUI launching). The Dockerfile runs
# `playwright install --with-deps chromium` to fetch the actual browser
# binary; that step is required beyond just this pip package. Pinned exact
# (not >=) -- a loose range here sent pip's resolver into a multi-thousand-
# second backtracking loop re-walking unrelated packages (uvicorn, one
# version at a time) trying to satisfy the whole graph; an exact pin skips
# that search entirely.
playwright==1.48.0

# Real on-demand webcam capture (node_agent_stub.py's /camera_snapshot).
# Only ever actually exercised when node_agent_stub.py runs natively on the
# real machine (see scripts/start-node-agent.ps1) -- the container has no
# camera hardware to open, same as it has no display for app_launcher.py.
# -headless variant: this runs inside a server container with no GUI of its
# own anyway, so the regular package's Qt/GTK GUI bindings would be dead
# weight -- headless drops that, which also shrinks its own dependency
# surface (helps the exact-pin reasoning above too). Also pinned exact for
# the same backtracking reason.
opencv-python-headless==4.10.0.84

# Real QR code generation (everyday_tools.py's generate_qr_code).
qrcode==7.4.2
